reuse.why: Hooks into assertBankAccountNotLinked, the pre-flight check every one of the six link handlers already awaits before any side effect.

duplication.why: The closed-account rule is written once; no handler repeats it.

placement.why: Right layer (accounts/app.ts pre-link guard) but folded into a function named for the one-link-per-bank-account rule, so the name no longer describes what it asserts; a sibling assertion or rename would fit better.

scope.why: Only the guard, a focused test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Single guard covering all providers is easy to own; the misleading function name is the main cost.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All link handlers go through assertBankAccountNotLinked.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, awaited first by all six *-accounts-link handlers.
